name: USA
description: US route: research and wellness subscriptions plus pharma and research work from 2027; one FDA 510(k) (product code OLT) cleared mid-2028 opens the clinical segments from 2029.

opening.note: The US entity starts with no cash. Any money for the US route comes from the main round or a grant.

settings.notes: FX: 1 EUR = 1.1219 USD (EUR/USD close 20 Oct 2026, Pound Sterling Live), so 1 USD = 0.8913 EUR; dollar figures are kept in each note. FDA pathway: one Traditional 510(k) under product code OLT for the clinician-facing analysis software, pre-submission Mar 2027, submission Dec 2027, clearance assumed Jul 2028, so clinical revenue starts 2029. Tax: 25.5% is the 2026 US average combined federal + state rate (Tax Foundation, Oct 2026); Texas would be 21%. All prices are planning figures not yet tested with US customers.

plans.name: NeuroJournal subscription (Research Use Only / wellness)
plans.note: Same price as the EU model (about $21.30). Cost to deliver per user per month taken from the EU business model; US HIPAA-grade hosting may raise it (assumption).

plans.name: Certified app for people with epilepsy and caregivers
plans.note: Cash-pay subscription after FDA clearance, about $21.30 a month. Assumption: patient-facing use is covered by the 510(k) or a follow-on submission; no US insurer pays for this today.

plans.name: Research study work package
plans.note: $15,000 per study, matching the EU €15,000 price. Kept close to cost-neutral (90% cost) as in the EU model; assumption.

plans.name: Epilepsy centre, per monitored patient
plans.note: $25 per monitored patient per month (assumption). If remote physiologic monitoring codes apply, the practice bills about $99 a month (99454 $47 + 99457 $52, Tenovi Dec 2025), but the CY2027 Medicare proposal cuts these codes and limits them to employed staff, and no EEG product has been shown billing RPM.

plans.name: Pharma pilot
plans.note: $50,000 pilot, delivery cost $16,000, derived from the €45K / ~€15K EU assumption. Not validated with any sponsor.

plans.name: Home-EEG service partner subscription
plans.note: $5,000 a month including 50 monitored 72-hour studies, plus $75 per extra study; at ~83 studies a month (1,000 a year) the bill is ~$7,475. Delivery cost ~$15 per study (assumption). Benchmarks: Ceribell Clarity $5,000 a month list (S-1, Oct 2024); Persyst ~$1,530 a month equivalent (Nov 2025).

segments.name: US academic researchers (Research Use Only)
segments.marketLabel: US labs doing human EEG research (assumption)
segments.note: No verified count of US human-EEG labs was found; 2,000 is an assumption. Ramp mirrors the EU single-user ramp. No FDA clearance needed for research use.

segments.name: US people with epilepsy and caregivers
segments.note: Market: ~3.4M with active epilepsy (2.9M adults, 456K children; CDC, updated May 2024). Starts 2029, after the assumed Jul 2028 510(k) clearance. 1,000 users in 2031 is 0.03% of the market (assumption).

segments.name: US research organisations (study work packages)
segments.note: Ramp is an assumption; no US research-organisation count found. Revenue is close to cost-neutral; its value is evidence and references.

segments.name: US epilepsy centres (NAEC level 3 and 4)
segments.note: NAEC has 'more than 260' member centres (NAEC guideline paper, PMC10962912; undated count); level 3/4 split not found. 50 monitored patients per centre is an assumption (EU model used 250). Hospital sales cycles are long.

segments.name: US pharma sponsors (epilepsy trials)
segments.note: 20 industry-sponsored epilepsy trials started in 2025 (ClinicalTrials.gov, checked 12 Aug 2026; global, not US-only). No pharma interviews yet, so the ramp is an assumption. Competitor signal: Cumulus Neuroscience added Muse S Athena to its CNS-trial platform (Jul 2026).

segments.name: US wellness EEG headset owners
segments.note: Assumption: 40% of the 116,430 reachable headset owners in the EU model's global wellness funnel are in the US. Muse alone reports 'hundreds of thousands of users' (BrainFutures, undated). BrainBit owners are counted but BrainBit is paused for any US product pending an ownership and sanctions screen.

segments.name: US home-EEG service partners
segments.note: Stratus, CortiCare and Neurotech are the named targets; 10 national providers is an assumption. Partners bill Medicare 95700 + 95708/95709 (~$2,843 technical for a monitored 72-hour study, Novitas TX / First Coast FL 2026). Medicare paid 17,372 long-term EEG setups in 2024 (CMS).

costs.name: US clinical and business development hire
costs.note: Base $90,673 a year (Clinical Specialist, Medical Devices, Salary.com, Oct 2026) × 1.3 loading (assumption) = $9,823 a month fully loaded. Half an FTE from 2028, growing to 2.

costs.name: FDA 510(k): pre-submission, validation, submission
costs.note: 2027: $45,000 for pre-submission (free FDA fee until Oct 2027), US Agent, QMSR gap work. 2028: $150,000 for consultant, ~30-recording validation study, cybersecurity file and the $7,163 small-business 510(k) fee (FY2027). Totals are assumptions pending a consultant quote; a De Novo for a cognitive-effects claim is not modelled.

costs.name: FDA establishment registration
costs.note: $13,785 a year, FY2027 rate, no small-business discount (Pure Global, Aug 2026). Assumed flat after 2027.

costs.name: US marketing and paid acquisition
costs.note: Assumption: ~$80 (about €71) paid acquisition per new subscriber plus content and partner materials; no sourced US benchmark found for this product.

costs.name: US tools, HIPAA-grade cloud and compliance software
costs.note: Assumption: US-region hosting, compliance tooling and CRM. No office.

costs.name: Payment processing and app-store fees
costs.note: Blended assumption. Consumer subscriptions via the App Store pay 15% under Apple's Small Business Program (under $1M proceeds; App Ops, May 2026); B2B invoices pay ~0-3% card or transfer fees. Most US revenue is B2B, so the blend is low.

costs.name: US entity, legal and insurance
costs.note: Delaware registered agent $125 + franchise tax ~$400 a year (Clerky); startup median premiums E&O $3,700, cyber $2,900, general liability $180 (Vouch, May 2026, not medtech-specific). 2027 adds $5,000 formation legal; 2028 adds $15,000 a year US legal; from 2029 adds $10,000 product liability once cleared (assumption).

costs.name: AES annual meeting presence
costs.note: Commercial booth $3,400 per 10x10 (AES exhibitor page, 2024 meeting) plus travel and registration, about $8,000 a year in total (assumption).

costs.name: HIPAA compliance set-up
costs.note: $15,000 one-off for a HIPAA risk assessment, policies and business associate agreements before clinical partners (assumption).
